marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Century of warfare the history of the United States at war in the 20th century. World War I 1914-1918 : World War II (part 1) 1939-1943

World War I revisits "the causes of the war, its early years and the American entrance into the conflict" through to the celebration "with all America as the war ends and the world has been made safe for democracy." The history of World War II "retraces the birth of the war and records the initial Axis' success as their rampage goes unchecked; America's entry into the war "as the war is suddenly thrust upon the United States at Pearl Harbor and how she rises to the challenge.
